caption:
Bhari ply chhodho aur switch kijiye lightweight PP shuttering sheet par jo paani se bilkul nahi phoolti.

Sahi handling ke saath ply se 2-3 guna zyada chalti hai aur har dhalai par milta hai smooth concrete finish. Pan-India dispatch Raipur, Durg, Bhilai godown se.

Apne thekedar aur mistri doston ke saath zaroor share karein.
